comment: The Android SDK packages the standard Gradle build of mobile/android needs (AGP 9.4.1: compileSdk 36; its DEFAULT_BUILD_TOOLS_REVISION is 36.0.0, read from com.android.builder.core.ToolsRevisionUtils in builder-9.4.1.jar). Archive URLs, sizes and SHA-1 values are copied from Google's official repository metadata. Every package is under the Android SDK License Agreement, which only the owner may accept (sdkmanager --licenses). Nothing here accepts it.
